description.value: Breathe Bikes is Merritt's full-service local bike shop, stocking quality bikes from children's balance bikes to electric road, mountain, and hybrid models alongside a wide range of parts, accessories, and cycling apparel. Professional technicians handle everything from minor adjustments to major overhauls, with free estimates available on arrival. The shop also offers bike rentals, making it a practical resupply and service point for touring cyclists passing through the Nicola Valley.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at breathebikes.ca is fully accessible and corroborates all OSM contact details (address, phone number). The Service & Repair subpage explicitly confirms professionally trained technicians who assess needs on visit and strive for quick turnaround; the navigation and footer list 'Rentals' as a dedicated service. The website also features a broad accessories catalog including packs, racks, and baskets alongside a comprehensive parts catalog, supporting touring parts availability.
concerns: Name discrepancy: OSM records 'BreatheBikes' (no space) while the website consistently uses 'Breathe Bikes' (with space). OSM name retained per schema rules.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An active, full-service bike shop with professional repair staff, bike rentals, and a broad parts/accessories inventory in Merritt — a clear fit for the WWC touring cyclist directory.

Touring parts stocked.detail: Accessories catalog includes packs, racks, and baskets; parts catalog covers cassettes, chains, derailleurs, cables, brakes, seatposts, and other touring-relevant components

Bike rentals.detail: Website navigation and footer explicitly list 'Rentals' as a service category, with a dedicated 'Rentals — Learn More' link on the homepage

E-bike service.detail: Shop sells electric bicycles (hybrid e-bikes, electric mountain bikes, electric road bikes) and service section covers 'All major brands'; e-bike-specific maintenance products (Muc-Off eBike Dry Lube) sold in store

wow_evidence: professionally trained technicians... Rentals as a dedicated service
